description: This Kotlin source file defines a MicCaptureManager class responsible for managing microphone input and speech recognition in an Android app. It handles starting/stopping listening sessions, processing recognition results, managing conversation state, and interfacing with a gateway for voice communication. The file also includes related data classes and enums for voice conversation roles and entries.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: Enum class representing roles in a voice conversation: User or Assistant.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: Data class for a single entry (message) in the voice conversation, including ID, role, text, and streaming status.

classes.name: MicCaptureManager
classes.description: Main class managing microphone input, speech recognition, and conversation state; handling recognition events, gateway interactions, and TTS pauses.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables microphone listening, starting/stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: pauseForTts
methods.description: Pauses recognition while TTS (text-to-speech) is speaking.

methods.name: resumeAfterTts
methods.description: Resumes recognition after TTS finishes.

methods.name: onGatewayConnectionChanged
methods.description: Updates internal state based on gateway connection status.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes events received from the voice gateway, updating conversation entries based on recognition payloads.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts speech recognition session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops recognition and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startListeningSession
methods.description: Configures and begins a speech recognition session.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of recognition after an error or timeout.

methods.name: queueRecognizedMessage
methods.description: Adds recognized text to message queue and conversation history.

methods.name: scheduleTranscriptFlush
methods.description: Schedules flushing of partial transcripts to finalize recognition results.

methods.name: publishQueue
methods.description: Publishes current message queue to observers.

methods.name: sendQueuedIfIdle
methods.description: Sends the next queued message if recognition is idle and gateway is connected.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets up timeout for awaiting gateway response after sending a message.

methods.name: completePendingTurn
methods.description: Marks current message exchange as complete and proceeds to next.

methods.name: queuedWaitingStatus
methods.description: Returns status string indicating queued messages waiting for gateway.

methods.name: appendConversation
methods.description: Adds a new message entry to the conversation history.

methods.name: updateConversationEntry
methods.description: Updates a specific conversation message by ID.

methods.name: upsertPendingAssistant
methods.description: Adds or updates the assistant's message in conversation history.

methods.name: playAssistantReplyAsync
methods.description: Speaks out the assistant's reply asynchronously.

methods.name: disableMic
methods.description: Disables microphone with specific status message.
